subject: [PATCH 54/60] mm/migrate: route explicit NUMA migration to private nodes

reviews.author: Gregory Relay
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that private nodes are only reachable through their private zonelist, and requested the use of ALLOC_ZONELIST_PRIVATE flag in alloc_migration_target() when migrating to a private node.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Linux kernel's memory migration functionality to allow explicit NUMA (Non-Uniform Memory Access) migration to private nodes. Currently, private nodes are not reachable through the standard allocation mechanism due to their unique zonelist configuration. The patch introduces a new flag, ALLOC_ZONELIST_PRIVATE, which enables the use of the private zonelist for allocation when migrating pages to a private node. This change affects the move_pages and migrate_pages system calls, as well as the alloc_migration_target function. Additionally, HugeTLB folios are still excluded from migration to private nodes due to their specific memory characteristics.
